scripts.build: ANDROID_HOME=/home/user/Android/Sdk PATH="$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools" JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.rebuild: npm run uninstall && npm run build && npm run install && npm run launch
scripts.dev: npm run rebuild & npm run scrcpy
